Kyle Doherty / Fashion

Roadkill

Dallas, TX / 202417 photographs
About the project

Shot at Production House in Dallas, Roadkill is a loud, pop-infused story inspired by queer identity and the saturated chaos of 1980s Americana. Kyle Doherty led creative direction and styling around the idea of two renegades on the run, with a 1969 Thunderbird as the backdrop.

With model Lily Savage and bold makeup by Kelsey Ikler, the shoot leaned into dramatic lighting, vivid color, and a sense of cinematic rebellion.
